title: Discover Shanghai | From Dynasty Tales to Modern Trails
highlights: Discover Shanghai’s dynamic blend of historic charm and futuristic innovation, from the colonial Bund to the towering skyline of Pudong, offering unforgettable experiences.
Discover rare species like pandas and golden monkeys as you explore themed zones recreating natural habitats at the Shanghai Zoo, offering an immersive wildlife experience.
Step back in time as you walk along the Shanghai Southern Great Wall, an ancient fortification built during the Eastern Jin Dynasty to protect the region from invasions.
Marvel at the exquisite jade Buddha statues from Myanmar in the Jade Buddha Temple and admire its intricate Buddhist artistry.
Glide between the Bund’s colonial elegance and Pudong’s modern skyscrapers as you cruise on the Huangpu River, offering a unique perspective of Shanghai.

meal_plans.name: Bermuda Plan
meal_plans.description: The Bermuda meal plan offers three meals at select restaurants, including breakfast, lunch, and dinner along with drinks included. Ideal for a hassle-free, all-inclusive dining experience.

meal_plans.name: Dinner Plan
meal_plans.description: The Dinner Plan provides guests with two meals included in their stay: breakfast and dinner.

meal_plans.name: American Plan
meal_plans.description: It includes all three major meals, breakfast, lunch, and dinner for the length of your stay. Generally, the rates on this plan are higher but offer a good value for your money, and of course, added convenience.

meal_plans.name: Modified American Plan
meal_plans.description: Also known as Half Board or Half Pension meal plan. It is a modified version of the American Plan and includes a room stay with breakfast and a choice between lunch and dinner.

meal_plans.name: Continental Plan
meal_plans.description: It is where your room stay involves a daily breakfast at the hotel. The hotel can either affix its option of breakfast menu or provide in the dining area for a buffet breakfast. Also, whether the room service provides the breakfast or in a general dining area, depends from hotel to hotel.

meal_plans.name: European Plan
meal_plans.description: Only the stay is included in the rates and that you will have to pay extra for using the hotel’s dining facilities. This can be called the “Room Only” Plan.

days.title: Arrival in Shanghai | Day at Leisure
days.desc: Welcome to China! Upon your arrival at Shanghai Pudong International Airport, get driven to your hotel. After check-in, spend the rest of your day at leisure, where you can explore the city at your own pace. You can stroll along the Bund, Shanghai’s iconic waterfront promenade, and take in breathtaking views of the Huangpu River. Also, you can indulge in Chinese history and art at the Shanghai Museum, or shop along Nanjing Road, one of the world’s most vibrant shopping streets.

days.title: Visit to Shanghai Zoo
days.desc: Today, head to Shanghai Zoo, a haven for over 6,000 animals, including rare and endangered species like giant pandas and golden monkeys. Once there, stroll through themed zones that recreate diverse habitats, offering a unique glimpse into the natural world. Don’t miss the chance to see the zoo’s two famous pandas, a true highlight of your visit! Also, watch educational exhibits that provide insight into vital conservation efforts. After an amazing time, return to your hotel.

days.title: Southern Great Wall Day Trip
days.desc: Today, head to Shanghai Station on your own, where you'll meet your guide before boarding a bullet train to Linhai. Upon reaching, begin your tour by walking along the Jiangnan Great Wall, admiring its ancient, weathered stones while soaking in the stunning scenic views. Next, soak in the charm of Ziyang Old Street and experience local life firsthand, from handcrafted goods to regional delicacies. Afterward, hop on the bullet train back to Shanghai and from the station return to your hotel.

days.title: Half-Day Shanghai City Tour | Visit to Oriental Pearl Tower | Hungpu River Cruise Experience
days.desc: Today, explore Shanghai on a city sightseeing tour. Start with a visit to the Jade Buddha Temple, home to exquisite Myanmar jade statues. Next, stroll through the Yu Garden, a Ming-era haven of pavilions & koi ponds. Also, visit the historic Longhua Temple & Pagoda & ascend the Oriental Pearl Tower, offering stunning skyline views of Shanghai. Later, get driven to Shiliupu Wharf for an amazing Huangpu River Cruise, soaking in the views of Pudong’s modern skyscrapers & the Bund’s colonial charm.

days.title: Departure Day
days.desc: This morning, bid farewell to Shanghai as you check out from your hotel. Take in the final glimpses of the city's dynamic skyline as you board your transfer to the airport. Upon reaching the airport, board your flight back home, marking the end to your amazing trip!
